# Board of Trustees

- **Alex M. Dunne**, President — Co-Founder, Locomotive Partners LLC (nominated 2024)
- **Bob Perkins**, Vice President — Residential Remodeling, CB Construction (nominated 2024)
- **Kate Suski**, Treasurer — Vice President of Real Estate Development, Ryan Companies US, Inc. (nominated 2022)
- **Walter Plimpton**, Secretary — Retired airline pilot (nominated 2005)
- **Clay Gustaves** — Land Representative, Williams (nominated 2018)
- **Rob Corser, AIA**, President Emeritus — Associate Professor in Architecture, University of Washington (nominated 2021)
- **Elsie Hulsizer** — Author, photographer, and environmental professional (nominated 2009)
- **Johnny Ohta** — Counselor, UDYC and YouthCare Orion Center (nominated 2015)
- **Randolph Urmston** — Attorney in private practice (nominated 2019)
- **John L. Brown** — Category Leader, Amazon.com (nominated 2021)
- **Sage Stargrove** (nominated 2026)

## Joining the Board

Interested in joining the board? Start with an introductory meeting with our Executive Director, Josh Anderson: [janderson@cwb.org](mailto:janderson@cwb.org). We encourage prospective trustees to attend a board meeting and serve as an advisory member on a committee first.
